require 'sinatra'
require 'net/http'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'rack/session'

class ProxyConfig
  FEATURE_FLAGS = {
    'enable_cors_headers' => true,
    'enable_request_logging' => true,
    'enable_session_binding' => false,
    'enable_origin_relaxation' => true,
    'strict_referer_check' => true,
    'csrf_token_validation' => true
  }

  def self.flag_enabled?(flag)
    FEATURE_FLAGS.fetch(flag, false)
  end

  def self.security_policy
    policy = {}
    policy[:csrf_protected] = flag_enabled?('csrf_token_validation')
    policy[:origin_checked] = !flag_enabled?('enable_origin_relaxation')
    policy[:session_bound] = flag_enabled?('enable_session_binding')
    policy
  end
end

class CSRFProtection
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    request = Rack::Request.new(env)
    
    if state_changing_request?(request)
      unless csrf_safe?(request, env)
        return [403, {'Content-Type' => 'text/plain'}, ['CSRF validation failed']]
      end
    end
    
    @app.call(env)
  end

  private

  def state_changing_request?(request)
    ['POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH'].include?(request.request_method)
  end

  def csrf_safe?(request, env)
    return true unless ProxyConfig.flag_enabled?('csrf_token_validation')
    
    session = env['rack.session'] || {}
    session_token = session[:csrf_token]
    
    # Check token from header or form param
    request_token = request.env['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] || request.params['csrf_token']
    
    # Origin validation layer
    origin_safe = validate_origin(request)
    
    # Combined policy evaluation
    evaluate_protection(session_token, request_token, origin_safe)
  end

  def validate_origin(request)
    return true unless ProxyConfig.flag_enabled?('strict_referer_check')
    
    origin = request.env['HTTP_ORIGIN']
    referer = request.env['HTTP_REFERER']
    
    if origin
      trusted_origins = ['http://localhost:4567', 'https://app.internal.corp']
      return trusted_origins.any? { |o| origin.start_with?(o) }
    end
    
    if referer
      trusted_origins = ['http://localhost:4567', 'https://app.internal.corp']
      return trusted_origins.any? { |o| referer.start_with?(o) }
    end
    
    # No origin or referer header present
    # When origin_relaxation is enabled, allow requests without origin headers
    ProxyConfig.flag_enabled?('enable_origin_relaxation')
  end

  def evaluate_protection(session_token, request_token, origin_safe)
    policy = ProxyConfig.security_policy
    
    # If origin check passed AND csrf validation is active, require token match
    # If origin_relaxation is enabled, origin_safe may be true even without headers
    if policy[:csrf_protected] && policy[:origin_checked]
      return secure_compare(session_token.to_s, request_token.to_s)
    end
    
    # Relaxed mode: origin check OR token check
    if policy[:csrf_protected] && !policy[:origin_checked]
      return origin_safe || secure_compare(session_token.to_s, request_token.to_s)
    end
    
    origin_safe
  end

  def secure_compare(a, b)
    return false if a.empty? || b.empty?
    return false if a.bytesize != b.bytesize
    
    l = a.unpack('C*')
    r = b.unpack('C*')
    result = 0
    l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
    result == 0
  end
end

class ProxyApp < Sinatra::Base
  use Rack::Session::Cookie, secret: SecureRandom.hex(32)
  use CSRFProtection

  BACKEND_HOSTS = {
    'api' => 'http://internal-api.corp:8080',
    'auth' => 'http://auth-service.corp:8081',
    'admin' => 'http://admin-panel.corp:8082'
  }

  before do
    session[:csrf_token] ||= SecureRandom.hex(32)
  end

  get '/csrf-token' do
    content_type :json
    { token: session[:csrf_token] }.to_json
  end

  get '/proxy/:service/*' do
    service = params[:service]
    path = params[:splat].first
    proxy_request(service, path, 'GET')
  end

  post '/proxy/:service/*' do
    service = params[:service]
    path = params[:splat].first
    proxy_request(service, path, 'POST')
  end

  delete '/proxy/:service/*' do
    service = params[:service]
    path = params[:splat].first
    proxy_request(service, path, 'DELETE')
  end

  private

  def proxy_request(service, path, method)
    backend = BACKEND_HOSTS[service]
    halt 404, 'Unknown service' unless backend

    uri = URI("#{backend}/#{path}")
    
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.open_timeout = 5
    http.read_timeout = 10

    req = case method
    when 'GET' then Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
    when 'POST'
      r = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
      r.body = request.body.read
      r.content_type = request.content_type || 'application/json'
      r
    when 'DELETE' then Net::HTTP::Delete.new(uri)
    end

    req['X-Forwarded-For'] = request.ip
    req['X-Request-ID'] = SecureRandom.uuid

    if ProxyConfig.flag_enabled?('enable_request_logging')
      log_request(service, path, method)
    end

    response = http.request(req)
    
    status response.code.to_i
    headers 'Content-Type' => response['Content-Type']
    
    if ProxyConfig.flag_enabled?('enable_cors_headers')
      headers 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' => request.env['HTTP_ORIGIN'] || '*'
      headers 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials' => 'true'
    end
    
    response.body
  end

  def log_request(service, path, method)
    puts "[PROXY] #{Time.now.iso8601} #{method} /#{service}/#{path} from #{request.ip}"
  end
end

ProxyApp.run! if __FILE__ == $0
